content.comment_body: Hello! I'm new to the [product_name] environment and currently working on my dissertation. I need to obtain temperature and humidity results from a CR6 DataLogger by Campbell Scientific ([url]). While I'm figuring out how to extract information from the CR6, I need help with [product_name] programming. I've checked many forum posts, but I want some guidance. How can I map these entries, such as integrating them in [product_name] Comfort? I've watched videos about master/slave setups between [product_name] modules but haven't found any that connect an external device as a slave. These readings are important for creating an automated control system. Thank you!
Why did you start a new topic for the same issue? You already have your own topic here: [url]
The attachment demonstrates using [product_name] as a Modbus client, including comments in the example program.
Hello [user_name], I appreciate your reply. However, the program won't open and displays an error. I'm using [product_name] Comfort [version_no].

To use Modbus and a [product_name] with [article_no], you'll need a more recent version of [product_name] Comfort. If you have a full version of [product_name] Comfort [version_no] (not a demo), you can freely upgrade to the current version [version_no]. Download it here: [document]. The package is about 1.3 GB. Make sure to run the installer as an administrator. After installation, you'll be able to open the file shared by [user_name].
That sounds great! I'll follow these steps and get back with any results.
This is exactly what I needed! The comments in the example are very helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: The user experienced difficulty connecting a Campbell Scientific CR6 Datalogger to [product_name] using [product_name] Comfort due to data mapping issues and software version incompatibility. Guidance on upgrading the software version resolved the problem. This emphasizes the importance of clear instructions, software compatibility, and practical examples for users new to automation integrations.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipated straightforward advice, compatible software and example files, and step-by-step instructions for linking external devices to [product_name] for automation control.
pain_keywords: lack of examples for external device integration
